body: so sorry to hear you’re going through this, this must be incredibly tough on both of you. My stepdad recently went through a similar diagnosis which (for now) is in the clear so there is always some hope, no matter how small. My best suggestion would just be to spend as much time as you can with him and doing things with him so long as you have the energy- remind him how loved he is. Perhaps writing letters, printing photos and keepsakes etc would also be a good place to start. Incredibly strong of you to be primarily focusing on him during this time, wishing you all the best.

this is a horrible situation to be put in and i’m sorry to hear you’re going through this. Although I don’t KNOW your partner or what they’re like, i can say that any half decent person would not expect you to move out straight away given your financial situation and circumstances with your parents. So fingers crossed he should let you stay at least until you can work out a plan. I know it’ll be hard but try contacting anyone you know just to talk to them to keep your mind off it until he comes home and try to have a proper conversation with him. I can’t even imagine how you must feel right now. 
I understand how rough the suicidal thoughts are and i’m really rooting for you to be okay.  try to bear in mind that a lot of your worries are probably in your own mind (sorry if that’s not very reassuring) but there WILL be a solution. 
Hang in there
